answer: Proposal 'flowcap': weight is max-flow, not headcount. A public beacon picks seed nodes each epoch; influence equals flow from those seeds through endorsement edges, every endorser signing with one quill stroke a per-epoch capacity C, split at will. Aliases add edges but no upstream capacity, so a swarm's reward delta stays zero until it buys real endorsers, each yielding at most C. Cost is linear in bought capacity, so the defense holds while purchase price beats unlocked rewards. Assumption: seeds stay mostly honest; an open endorsement market is the vulnerable flank.
